snippet.title: Duco - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Duco is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world, built around card-based roguelike mechanics. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/48...
